Channels.note: Product name; stays in English. The common noun 'channel' is translated as 'canal'.

Calls.note: Product name; stays in English. The common noun 'call' is translated as 'chamada'.

System Console.note: Established rendering across webapp and server; capitalize both words when used as the UI area name.

marketplace.note: Kept in English throughout existing translations (e.g. 'Marketplace de aplicativos', 'URL do Marketplace'); masculine noun ('o Marketplace').

team.note: Feminine. Consistently 'equipe' in existing translations; avoid 'time' (appears rarely, e.g. 'Time Padrão' in one server string).

post.note: Majority rendering in newer strings. Legacy strings mix 'postagem' and untranslated 'post'; prefer 'publicação' (noun) / 'publicar' (verb).

thread.note: Clear majority across webapp, mobile, server, and Calls. A few webapp strings use 'fio' ('Seguir o fio'); avoid it.

direct message.note: Capitalized 'Mensagem Direta' when used as a feature name. Do not keep the 'DM' abbreviation; spell out.

pin.note: 'Fixar no Canal', 'fixado', 'mensagens fixadas'. Unpin = 'desafixar'. A few server strings use 'pinadas'/'Pinar'; avoid.

bookmark.note: Noun 'marcador'; verb 'adicionar um marcador'. Established in mobile and server strings.

saved messages.note: Save = 'salvar', unsave = 'remover de salvos'. Webapp legacy strings use 'Publicações Salvas'; mobile uses 'Mensagens Salvas' — prefer 'mensagens salvas'.

scheduled post.note: Majority rendering; 'programada' appears in a couple of server strings — avoid.

do not disturb.note: Established status name across webapp, mobile, and server.

online.note: Majority rendering for the availability status (server commands, mobile). Some webapp strings keep 'Online'; prefer 'conectado' for the status name.

offline.note: Some webapp strings keep 'Offline'; prefer 'desconectado' for the status name.

guest.note: Consistent majority; one webapp string uses 'Visitante' — avoid. Same word as the past participle of 'convidar' (to invite); context usually disambiguates.

system admin.note: Short label 'Admin do Sistema' also appears; prefer the full form in prose.

sign in.note: Existing translations are inconsistent ('Conecte-se', 'Entrar', 'fazer login'); 'fazer login' is the overall majority. For short buttons 'Entrar' is acceptable; translate 'log in' and 'sign in' identically.

sign out.note: 'Log Out' is consistently 'Sair'. Translate 'log out' and 'sign out' identically.

join.note: 'Entrar' for channels/teams ('Entrar no canal'); 'participar' is used for calls and open teams; avoid 'juntar-se' except for groups where it already appears.

leave.note: Existing UI mixes 'Deixar o Canal' (majority for channels) and 'Sair da Equipe' (teams). Either is acceptable; keep each context internally consistent.

archive.note: 'Arquivar Canal', 'arquivado'. Note 'arquivo' also means 'file' in Portuguese; avoid ambiguous noun uses.

mute.note: For channel notifications: 'Silenciar Canal' (majority). Legacy strings use 'Mutar'/'Ativar Mudo'; avoid. Unmute = 'desativar o silêncio' or 'reativar notificações' per context.

favorite.note: Noun/category 'Favoritos'; verb 'favoritar' (already used in webapp); unfavorite = 'remover dos favoritos'.

search.note: Corpus mixes 'Procurar' (main search bar), 'pesquisar' (results, groups, members), and 'buscar'. 'Pesquisar'/'pesquisa' is the overall majority; noun = 'pesquisa'.

trigger word.note: Established without hyphen in existing strings; plural 'palavras gatilho'.

plugin.note: Kept in English (masculine: 'o plugin'); avoid the hyphenated 'plug-in' that appears once.

bot.note: Kept in English; 'conta de bot' for bot account.

role.note: Consistent majority ('Função de Membro', 'Funções de Administrador'); avoid 'papel'.

seat.note: No existing translation found in the repos; 'assento' is the common pt-BR SaaS pricing term. 'Licença de usuário' is an acceptable descriptive alternative.

trial.note: Corpus splits between 'avaliação' and 'teste' ('teste gratuito'); 'avaliação (gratuita)' is slightly more common in newer strings — standardize on it.

workspace.note: Clear majority; a few server email strings keep 'workspace' — avoid.

subscription.note: One admin sidebar string uses 'Inscrição'; prefer 'assinatura'.

unread.note: Agrees in gender/number: 'mensagens não lidas', 'canais não lidos'; 'Não lidos' for the Unreads view.

channel purpose.note: Majority 'propósito'; a couple of strings use 'finalidade' — avoid.

recap.note: No existing translation in the repos. 'Resumo' is natural for AI-generated summaries; Microsoft Teams uses 'recapitulação' if a distinct word from 'summary' is required.

agent.note: Masculine even when referring to the AI assistant; 'Agentes' for the feature area.

burn-on-read.note: No existing translation. Adjectival use: 'mensagem com autodestruição após leitura'; all-caps label: 'AUTODESTRUIÇÃO APÓS LEITURA'. Avoid literal 'queimar'.

magic link.note: No existing translation in the repos; 'link mágico' is the established pt-BR term (e.g. Slack, Notion).

personal access token.note: Majority in existing webapp/server strings. 'Token de acesso pessoal' (the GitHub/GitLab industry standard) appears once and is arguably better; keep 'individual' for consistency unless a global cleanup is done.

permalink.note: Kept in English in existing strings ('O permalink pertence...'); 'link permanente' is an acceptable alternative if translating.

username.note: Short form 'Usuário' is used in existing login/form labels; use the full 'nome de usuário' in prose.

display name.note: Majority; 'nome para exibição' also appears in server strings — prefer 'nome de exibição'.

collapsed reply threads.note: Mobile currently has 'Respostas de Tópicos Recolhidos', which inverts the meaning; prefer 'tópicos de resposta recolhidos' and keep it consistent as the feature name.

data retention.note: 'Política de Retenção de Dados' for data retention policy.

access control.note: 'controle de acesso baseado em atributos' for attribute-based access control.

onboarding.note: Kept in English in most server strings (masculine: 'o onboarding'). One webapp string uses 'Integração', which collides with 'integration' — avoid.

Town Square.note: Existing pt-BR translations keep the default channel name in English (server default-channel string is untranslated). Keep as-is for consistency with existing workspaces.

Off-Topic.note: Existing pt-BR translations keep this default channel name in English; keep as-is.
